h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bijapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bijapur

items.pText: Bijapur, now Vijayapura, is home to the Gol Gumbaz and lies in one of the driest parts of north Karnataka. Rain is light and uncertain, and summers are long and hot. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Bijapur's schools, colleges, housing layouts and public gardens. It comes from our factory in Vasai, about 410 km away, and our team or a Karnataka dealer installs it.

In a dry town, water for lawns is often scarce, and grass under play equipment rarely survives. Children's feet wear it down to bare earth, which turns to dust in summer and mud on the few rainy days. A surface that needs no watering makes more sense here. Rubber flooring under the play area stays usable all year with only sweeping, and it cushions falls better than hard ground.

richText.heading: A low-water playground for a dry district

c: Skip the lawn under the equipment and lay rubber flooring on a levelled, compacted base. Plant drought-hardy trees on the west and south sides for shade, and water them until they establish.
Neither galvanised pipe nor roto-moulded plastic is harmed by the dry heat here. Wipe slides and seats with a damp cloth to clear dust. Our
